title: Minim festival themes (themes/themes.json)
description: Version 1. Unknown fields are allowed everywhere: Minim ignores them, so new fields can be added later without breaking older apps.

version.description: Format version. Minim reads version 1. A bigger number means a change older apps can't read, so they ignore the file and keep normal Home.

date.description: A full date, YYYY-MM-DD, read in the phone's local date (IST for Gaurab).

id.description: Short and unique: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, like diwali-2026. Same as the asset folder name. Ids starting with _ are templates.

enabled.description: Optional, default true. false switches the festival off without deleting it.

end.description: Last day, inclusive. Same as start for a single day.

priority.description: Optional, default 0. When two festivals overlap, the higher number wins. A tie goes to the one higher up in the list.

wallpaper.description: Repo path of the Home wallpaper, inside themes/. WebP, 1080x2400 (9:20), under 300 KB.

colors.description: Optional backup colours for Home. Leave empty so Minim picks them from the wallpaper. Any colour set here replaces the automatic one.

text.description: Greeting, minim logo and top tab labels.

pill.description: Fill of the search pill and the Home mini player pill.

pillText.description: Text and icons on those pills.

burst.description: What bursts out of the heart when you like a song during the festival.

shape.description: One of the fixed shapes. An unknown shape falls back to dots.

colors.description: 1 to 6 colours, used in turn. Empty or missing = the cover's colour, as today.

greetings.description: The festival's own greetings, grouped like greetings/greetings.json. While the festival is on, only these rotate.

anytime.description: Plain lines, like the ones in greetings.json's "greetings" list without dates.

stats.description: Lines about the listening, like greetings.json's "stats" list.

greeting.description: Same fields as a greetings.json entry, without from / to / day / year (the festival's dates apply).
